_fragment.name: upscale-esrgan
_fragment.description: Super resolution through an ESRGAN-family upscale model: two nodes, no sampler, no prompt. ImageUpscaleWithModel tiles the frame internally and blends the seams, which is why a 24 MP photo goes through it in one run. The model's factor is fixed (4x for the one this ships with) and the engine resamples once when the op asked for 2x. Rebuild with `comfy workflow compose`; never hand-edit the compiled graph.
